lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Each column contains 4 to 6 circular high-luminance clusters within the mid-lateral field, forming a semi-ordered grid pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Clear vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular blobs; the blobs serve as anchor nodes within these vertical stripes, particularly prominent in the central third of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper lateral surface, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal side) to dark (ventral side) along each ridge line.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense clustering of smaller, higher-frequency white spots observed on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin and in the interstitial tissue between the gill slits.
